name: talkshow-1990s-marketing-tools
description: Cast modellato sul reel GoHighLevel del 2026-05-28 (ScreenRecording_05-28-2026 08-02-54). 5 archetipi-tool come ospiti trash + 1 protagonista calmo + 1 conduttrice. Test pensato per validare consistency di volti caricaturali su prompt action+emotion estremi (yelling, finger pointing, eyes popping).

characters.label: EMAIL MARKETING
characters.keyframePrompt: Photoreal portrait, vertical 9:16, medium close-up. A brash 1990s American daytime talk show guest: woman in her late 40s, bleached blonde teased and feathered hair, heavy blue eyeshadow, frosted pink lipstick, large gold hoop earrings, leopard print blouse with deep V-neck, gold chain. Studio backdrop with purple gel lighting and out-of-focus audience. Neutral expression looking at camera, ready-for-conflict energy. Slightly degraded VHS-era television aesthetic, soft film grain. No on-screen text. Just a candid frame from a real 1990s talk show.

videoVariations.action: yelling angrily at someone off-camera, pointing finger forward aggressively, mouth wide open
rolling eyes dramatically, crossing arms, sneering with disgust
standing up from chair, gesturing wildly with both hands while shouting
